set.description: For circles of positive radii r1,r2 and center distance d: d=r1+r2 gives external tangency; 0<d=|r1-r2| gives internal tangency; |r1-r2|<d<r1+r2 gives two intersections. If d=0 and r1=r2 the circles coincide. Outside these ranges they have no common point.
set.name: Relative positions of two circles

criteria: 能说出圆的面积用半径计算
set.description: 会用半径乘半径再乘圆周率求圆的面积。
set.name: Area of a circle

set.description: 圆心角为 n° 半径为 r 的扇形面积 S=nπr²/360=lr/2。
set.name: Area of a Sector

criteria: 能画出四类四边形的包含关系图
set.description: 正方形兼有矩形和菱形的性质，会判定正方形并梳理平行四边形、矩形、菱形、正方形的包含关系。
set.name: Properties and Criteria for Squares

criteria: 能说出三角形面积是等底等高平行四边形的一半
set.description: 会用底乘高除以 2 计算三角形的面积。
set.name: Area of a Triangle

criteria: 能由 d 与 r 判断位置
set.description: 直线与圆相离、相切、相交，对应圆心到直线的距离 d 与半径 r 的大小关系。
set.name: Position of a Line Relative to a Circle

set.description: 矩形的四个角都是直角，对角线相等且互相平分。
set.name: Properties of Rectangles

set.description: 菱形四边相等，对角线互相垂直平分且平分每组对角，面积等于对角线乘积的一半。
set.name: Properties of Rhombuses

set.description: 有一个角是直角的平行四边形、对角线相等的平行四边形、有三个角是直角的四边形是矩形。
set.name: Criteria for Rectangles

set.reason: Square properties and the inclusion diagram need rectangle meaning/properties, not the full repertoire of rectangle criteria. The proposed endpoint confuses a property family with recognition methods.
set.scope: Rectangle recognition methods as preparation for some square-recognition proofs

set.reason: The square target expressly combines rectangle and rhombus properties; rectangle meaning and its right-angle/equal-diagonal properties are the appropriate content, rather than the general rectangle recognition repertoire. Root checked both endpoint-based reviews; each identifies the stated content or conditional method rather than a curriculum-order claim.
set.scope: The rectangle-property component inherited by a square and its inclusion in the rectangle class

set.reason: The square target expressly combines rectangle and rhombus properties; equal sides and perpendicular diagonal properties belong to the property endpoint, rather than the general rhombus recognition repertoire. Root checked both endpoint-based reviews; each identifies the stated content or conditional method rather than a curriculum-order claim.
set.scope: The rhombus-property component inherited by a square and its inclusion in the rhombus class

set.reason: The tangent-radius property requires knowing what a tangent line is.
set.scope: meaning of tangent line

set.reason: The criterion explicitly permits triangles OR rectangles. Both external reviews turn that alternative into an unconditional requirement, but an L-shaped orthogonal figure can be split entirely into rectangles. Preserve triangle area as a component of the triangular-piece route without making every composite-area task use it.
set.scope: Calculating triangular pieces in a triangular partition of a composite area
